trust_center.repositoryDescription: Litmas AI Trust Center: security, privacy and compliance information, including the SOC 2 Type 1 report and HIPAA Security Compliance Assessment.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Email privacy@litmas.ai from your agency address with your name, agency, and the documents you need. Security documentation is shared under NDA.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Single cloud service offering, including the agentic associate and all the tools it uses, within one security boundary. Security category: Moderate.

current.service_desc: Litmas AI is a legal AI platform for litigation teams, hosted on AWS in the United States. At its core is an agentic associate that takes a litigator's request and calls the platform's tools to complete it: evidence mapping, legal research, citation validation and drafting. Every fact is traced to its source page and line, and drafts of motions, pleadings and responses are tied to that mapped record.
